crossRefs.note: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

translations.web: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
translations.bsb: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
translations.kjv: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made
translations.asv: And he made curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
